Welcome to West Guwahati Commerce College
The thickly populated area in between Gauhati University at Jalukbari and Maligaon is developing fast, industrially and commercially. A large number of ancillary commercial centres have grown up in and around the Head Quarters of N.F. Railway with hectic business activities during the last one decade. The need of professionally educated and trained youths especially in *Business Management *Accountancy and *Banking was acutely felt. For such potentially growing area, job oriented education, especially in Commerce Stream was found to be the need of the hour in view of ever increasing unemployment situation in the country. Keeping these aspects in view, a handful of academicians with the help of intellectuals of the locality gave birth to this institution as early as in May 1992.
Since then, the local aspirants for Commerce and Management Education, have been trained up under the devoted guidance of teachers, resulting in brilliant examination results under the Board of Assam Higher Secondary Education Council and the Gauhati University. The college is situated on the northern side of the Maligaon Over Bridge.The College in a building away from cacophony of city, the site is very ideal for both teaching and learning in a calm, quiet and serene atmosphere. From the point of view of communication, the College is just two minute's walking distance from the city bus route, with a stoppage at Baripara. It is only about 2 Kilometers distant from Gauhati University. The Assam Government has allotted 4 (Four) Bighas of land for the college, which we have developed with earth filling and constructed a big building consisting of 6 rooms near Assam Engineering College at Jalukbari..
